APPRECIATION  The City  Council  presented  a Certificate  of Appreciation  to Detective  John
  Affeld  for his 50 years of dedicated  service  to the City  of South  Gate.

3

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued a Proclamation  declaring  May  2025,  as Water
  Safety  and Drowning  Prevention  Month.

4

PROCLAMATION  The City  Council  issued a Proclatnation  declaring  April  26, 2025,  as the
  20th Annual  Earth  Day Celebration.

5
PERSONNEL  RF.CRUITMENT

& SELECTION  The City  Council  unanimously  received  and filed  the list of new and
  promoted  full-time  employees  hired  or promoted  during  March  2025.

CLOSED  SESSION  The Council  Members  recessed  into Closed  Session  at 5:57 p.m. and
  reconvened  at 6:42 p.m. withAll  Members  of Council  present.  City
  Attorney  Salinas  stated the discussion  was not finished,  so nothing  to
  report.  Mr. Salinas  recommended  the Council  make  a motion  to recess the
  Special  City  Council  Meeting  and return  after the Regular  City  Council
  Meeting.
